name: Pointer
description: A named pointer that follows the mouse inside a container, like a collaborator cursor: an arrow drawn in CSS with a name tag. It hides when the mouse leaves.

children.description: Content of the container the pointer lives in.

name.description: The text on the name tag.

color.description: Colour of the arrow and the tag, any CSS colour. Defaults to the primary action colour.

requirements: Decoration for mouse users: the pointer is aria-hidden, ignores the pointer (pointer-events none) and never takes focus
It never replaces keyboard focus and no information may depend on it
Not shown for touch or pen input, for prefers-reduced-motion, with isStill, or inside rdm-still
Hidden as soon as the mouse leaves the container; listeners are removed on unmount
Forced-colors: the arrow keeps its own colour (forced-color-adjust none) so it stays visible, and the tag keeps a border
screenReader: Not announced: the pointer is purely visual

use_when: Showing how a shared canvas could look with several people on it
Product tours and landing page demos
avoid_when: Real presence information: send that as text a screen reader can read
anti_patterns: Long names that cover the content
Relying on the pointer to show who is doing something
